scripts.prisma:validate: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma validate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:init: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma --name init
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:studio: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:seed: npm run prisma:sync-schema && dotenv -e .env -- prisma db seed --schema prisma/schema.prisma
